description: Opens Tickmi's free lucky draw (spinning wheel / slot machine random winner picker) pre-filled with the user's participant list, title and prize. Nothing is stored on a server: the list travels only inside the link, and the draw runs in the user's browser, ready to present on a big screen. Use when the user wants to randomly pick winners from 2–100 names.

language.description: Language of the page shown to participants: vi (Vietnamese) or en (English).

participants.description: Names (or name + ticket number), one per participant. 2 to 100.

prize.description: Prize name for the first round, e.g. "First prize".

title.description: Title shown on screen, e.g. "Year-end party lucky draw".

name: create_lucky_draw

expires_at.description: ISO time when the tool is deleted if not edited again.

manage_url.description: Private link for the creator to see results and edit. Keep it secret.

studio_import_url.description: invite only: opens Tickmi Studio to turn the card into an event with RSVP and QR check-in.

view_url.description: Link to share with participants (or to open the tool).

title: Open a lucky draw
